paragraphs.text: The official Magic: The Gathering Advanced Strategy Guide for Advanced and Expert Magic Players was published on September 18, 1998 by Thunder's Mouth Press.

The guide was designed with the serious, avid player in mind. The guide, written by Tim Dedopulos and Mark Justice . Justice, winner of the 1995 World Championships , provides players with the necessary information to successfully play and win one of the fastest growing games in the world.

Written for serious Magic players, the Advanced Strategy Guide features cards and techniques for the intricacies of high-level and tournament play. Topics include constructed deck vs. sealed deck ; evaluating cards; draft tournaments; metagame ; and Magic ethics. It features 100 color illustrations.
